MT.name: Zhao–Yuan modified Taylor

PTSC.name: Paired Taylor-series compensation
PTSC.access: Pauli coefficients, S0=I zeroth-order formula for the matched finite-target entry point.
PTSC.precision: Finite-cutoff LCU approximation statement; no matching root/dyadic full-support/bias certificate located.
PTSC.cost: Degree selection and IID factors are available; general Trotter remainder setup is a separate cost.
PTSC.control: Preserve phase and ordered products; do not grant free general-Q native implementation.

SCU.name: SCU / CTS including layered sampling
SCU.access: Pauli collection and layers; common Green query and legitimate Pauli relations permitted to both.
SCU.precision: Finite operator cutoff and left/right normalization separate from a G6 digital joint-law guarantee.
SCU.cost: Full coefficient collection is one path, not the only permitted path; layer setup and norm acquisition are chargeable.
SCU.control: Allow controlled-system/observable comparison; left/right channel draw is not automatically one coherent event.

SPS.name: Sparse Probabilistic Synthesis
SPS.access: Specified gate/process dictionary, coefficients and offline optimization; permit richer legal libraries.
SPS.precision: Process approximation/variance not automatically phase-sensitive M_tilde or a finite-confidence Bernstein guarantee.
SPS.cost: Library construction, coefficient solution, normalization and actual precision costs not free.
SPS.control: Controlled expanded process dictionary may be considered; off-diagonal/operator phase and dictionary acquisition must be matched.

IS.name: Resource-Optimal Importance Sampling
IS.access: Known ensemble p, actual proposal q and cost c; common Green and unnormalized coefficients allowed when acquired.
IS.precision: Existing-bias preservation under p/q does not remove coefficient approximation; moment/CLT scope not identical to finite Bernstein N.
IS.cost: Cost-optimal q normalization and queries are chargeable; no inherent requirement to know B_RA for c_tilde/pi weighting.
IS.control: Error-detection ZeroFill spends quantum executions before failure; G6 pre-rejection can occur before quantum execution.
